resolved_conflicts.explanation: Three sources give 1941 for the L-4 cab, but the 1971 notice says the building was built in 1942. The story gives 1941 and notes the disagreement.
The two lookout sites say the cab was removed in 1971. The 1971 notice says the building was in use until 1969 and does not record its removal, so the 1971 removal date rests on the two sites.

notes_for_editor: The L-4 build year (1941 in three sources, 1942 in the 1971 notice) and the removal date (1971 in two sites, while the notice says in use until 1969) disagree; the story says so. The NGS listing for QC0925 gives two rows, one with the surface-mark-destroyed code and one with no geodetic control, so the survey-mark remark is the weakest claim here.
